title: CCDC per-contribution metadata file (contribution.json)
description: Thin, contributor-authored metadata committed alongside each contribution. Declares only identity, license affirmation, and attestation; all provenance is CI-derived. See SCHEMA.md.

contributor_id.description: Stable contributor handle. Must equal the <contributor_id> path segment.

license.description: Affirmation that this contribution is licensed under the CCDC Data License v1.0.

right_to_contribute.description: The contributor affirms they have the right to contribute this data.

original_retained.description: The contributor affirms they retain the original input for possible re-sanitization.
